purpose: measure the inference-time sensitivity of one frozen SA4 policy to the LiDAR observation distribution, and attribute that sensitivity to the three TLNI layers, without any retraining
not_a_claim_about: training with TLNI versus training without TLNI (requires a retrained control arm)
real-robot navigation performance (no hardware arm exists)
whether sensor noise is beneficial or harmful in general
thesis table 5.6's published SR/CR values -- see gate_0_amendment_20260828; the corridor pedestrian-generation code has since changed and table 5.6 is not reproducible under the current source tree
figure_caption_required: 本圖量測的是同一顆已訓練策略在推論期對感測分布的敏感度，以及 TLNI 三層各自的相對影響；不是「以 TLNI 訓練優於不以 TLNI 訓練」的比較。

simulator_default.why_rejected: traced to the docstring defaults of lidar_vlp16_to_2d_bins, an observation function this lineage never uses, and recorded as 'Bug B' in train/train_charge_ac.py:918 (about 11 fake near-range distractors per frame drive lidar.min to about 0). A known-harmful distribution as the control arm would attribute the gap to the bug rather than to noise modeling.

grid.why_delay_is_held_fixed: sweeping delay and noise together would confound two factors; a delay sweep, if wanted, must be a separate table

preregistration.prediction: the sigma arm will differ from the ideal baseline by approximately zero; the discriminating differences will be carried by the bias and dropout arms
preregistration.mechanism: each 5-degree bin is the minimum over 80 rays, so per-ray sigma 8.672 mm is compressed to sd = sigma/sqrt(M) = 0.97 mm at bin level while introducing a systematic shift of about -2.1*sigma = -18 mm; per-ray jitter therefore barely enters the policy input, whereas offset and missing returns do
preregistration.if_confirmed: a generalizable mechanism finding: under a min-pool observation pipeline, per-ray Gaussian jitter is largely filtered out of the policy input; what survives is offset and dropout
preregistration.if_refuted: the min-pool compression is weaker than modeled and that itself requires explanation (e.g. rays within a bin are not equidistant, or clip-boundary effects dominate)

descriptive_rules.pooling: per-cell verdicts only; pooled numbers never replace per-cell judgement
descriptive_rules.pairing: pair by (scenario, evaluator_seed); closed-loop divergence forbids per-episode paired interpretation

this diagnostic cannot authorize an SA4 parent or launch SA5
SA4 remains HOLD with accepted_parent = null regardless of outcome

gate_0_amendment_20260828.why: gate 0 as originally specified FAILED for both corridor scenarios (corridor_lateral SR 88.08%->79.04%, CR 11.92%->20.96%, n 2190->2314; corridor_longitudinal SR 94.68%->71.07%, CR 5.29%->28.93%, n 3044->2558), while nav_native reproduced exactly (n 2251->2251, SR/CR within 0.03pp). deterministic+fixed-seed episode counts changing on the corridor scenarios only is a hard behavioral-drift signal, not noise. Root cause: source/.../mdp/events/long_corridor_replay.py and corridor_density.py (pedestrian density mix + interaction sampling order) were rewritten in commit 45bd5f23b29 (2026-08-25) and earlier commits after the 2026-08-17 run that produced thesis table 5.6; neither file was in the original 9-file FINGERPRINTED_SOURCES list, so the drift was invisible to the original gate design. checkpoint sha256, LiDAR noise pipeline, and the action/actuator pipeline are all ruled out (nav_native shares them and reproduced exactly). Full analysis: memory finding_table56_not_reproducible_head_20260828.

results_20260828.preregistration_outcome: CONFIRMED: sigma and bias are statistically indistinguishable from ideal (p > 0.45 in every scenario); dropout alone recovers 83% (lateral) to 89% (longitudinal, p=5.7e-37) of the full arm's effect size relative to ideal; nav_native shows no sensitivity to any arm (delta < 0.3pp, p > 0.7 throughout)
results_20260828.thesis_sentence: 在取最小值(min-pooling)的觀測管線下，逐射線的隨機抖動與逐環系統偏差幾乎不影響策略的推論期行為(sigma/bias兩臂與ideal統計上無法區分，p>0.45)；策略對訓練分布的敏感度幾乎完全由丟點/缺值主導——dropout單一機制即可複現full臂83-89%的效應量，且在行人縱向接近場景達到高度顯著(p=5.7e-37)。此發現屬於機制層級，適用於任何採用類似min-pooling觀測設計的系統。
